# opnsense_caddy_basic_auth (Resource)

Caddy basic authentication users (**Services ▸ Caddy Web Server ▸ Reverse Proxy ▸ Access**, plugin `os-caddy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_caddy_basic_auth" "scraper" {
  user     = "scraper"
  password = var.scraper_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Enter a password. It will be hashed with bcrypt. It can only be set and changed but will not be visible anymore.
- `user` (String) Enter a username. Afterwards, select it in a "Domain" or "Subdomain" to restrict access with Basic Auth.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Enter a description for this user. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Caddy basic auth user.
